== Objectives ==
Slay Ukorz Sandscalp and Ruuzlu within Zul'Farrak for Champion Taza'go at Sandmoon Village in Tanaris.
* [[Chief Ukorz Sandscalp]] slain
* [[Ruuzlu]] slain

==Description==
It has to be done. Ukorz Sandscalp and his foul right-hand man Ruuzlu have to be stopped.

Venture into our ancient city of Zul'Farrak. Kill Ukorz and Ruuzlu and come back to me.

There will not be celebration, or a feast. This is just what needs to happen. In time, de lands of Zul'Farrak will heal.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 6250 [[XP]]

==Progress==
Is Ukorz dead?

==Completion==
So it is done, I Thank you.

Ukorz Sandscalp was not always so brutal and cold, his mind be warped from the magic he and his lackeys dabbled within'. It almost be sad to think of what a promisin' future he brought when he first became chief, for it all to drift away like sand on de dunes.

Perhaps we find a new future now, all thanks to you mon.
